name: customer-360-intelligence-platform
description: Unified tooling entry point. Mirrors the Makefile for environments without make.

scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run types:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/backend.mjs -m ruff check src tests && node scripts/backend.mjs -m black --check src tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.types: npm run types:backend && npm run types:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.fmt:backend: node scripts/backend.mjs -m black src tests && node scripts/backend.mjs -m ruff check --fix src tests
scripts.fmt: npm run fmt:backend && npm run fmt:frontend
